title: 第12章 凶手是他？
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

头顶的冷气不停地往下吹着，吹得人鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。

林知渔睁开眼睛，看到了一个躺在手术台上的女人，以及一个背对着她站在手术台前的男人。

男人手里拿着一把泛着冷光的手术刀，不知道在想些什么，一直没动刀。

林知渔立马观察起了周围的环境。

这是一个比较窄小的手术室，除了一些医用器材，就只有前方那个稍大一点的手术台了。

此时的林知渔正站在角落里，毫无遮掩。

手术台前的男人敏锐地察觉到了什么，他猛地转头，直直地对上了角落里那双惊恐不安的眼眸。

待看清男人的长相时，林知渔瞳孔骤缩，满是不可置信。

竟然是他！

男人一双眼眸冰冷地打量着眼前这个“不请自来”的人。

林知渔不由得呼吸急促起来，面前的这个男人和她之前看到的那几个罪犯非常不同。

撞人的货车司机是癫狂，杀死余时夏的钱海是愤怒，家暴的男人是气急败坏……

而眼前这个人，是无任何感情的。

他不像是在看人，而是在看一个……死物？

“告诉我，你是怎么出现在这里的？”

林知渔咽了咽发紧的喉咙，不知道为什么，她的手有些发麻。

男人似乎没耐心等，他扭动了下脖子，抬脚，不紧不慢地走向林知渔。

林知渔下意识往后退了一步，后背却撞上了冰凉的墙面。

无路可退。

男人说：“我正好缺一个安静的观众，这个角色就交给你吧。”

林知渔死死地盯着面前的男人，她张了张嘴，发出略有些沙哑的声音，“你想干什么？”

男人勾了勾嘴角，“你会看到的。”

话音刚落，男人抬手就将一只针管扎进了林知渔的胳膊上，并直接将里面的液体推了进去。

“你……”

话还未说出口，林知渔就浑身无力地倒了下去。

男人再一次强调：“一定要做一个安静的观众哦。”

林知渔喘着气，费力地抬着头，看向手术台上那个不知道是昏迷了还是死了的女人——

长发，皮肤很白，露出的脖子上有一颗明显的黑痣。

林知渔想撑着地面起来，却使不出半分力气。

她没有办法救那个女人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The air-conditioning above the head kept blowing down, making people's skin crawl.

Lin Zhiyu opened his eyes and saw a woman lying on the operating table and a man standing in front of the operating table with his back to her.

The man held a scalpel with a cold light in his hand. He didn't know what he was thinking, but he never moved the scalpel.

Lin Zhiyu immediately observed the surrounding environment.

This is a relatively narrow operating room. Apart from some medical equipment, the only thing left is the slightly larger operating table in front.

At this time, Lin Zhiyu was standing in the corner, without any cover.

The man in front of the operating table was keenly aware of something. He turned his head sharply and looked directly into the frightened eyes in the corner.

When he saw the man's appearance clearly, Lin Zhiyu's pupils shrank suddenly, full of disbelief.

It's him!

The man looked at the "uninvited" person in front of him with cold eyes.

Lin Zhiyu couldn't help but breathe quickly. The man in front of her was very different from the criminals she had seen before.

The truck driver who hit someone was mad, Qian Hai who killed Yu Shixia was angry, and the man who committed domestic violence was furious...

The person in front of me has no emotions whatsoever.

He didn't seem to be looking at a person, but rather a... dead thing?

"Tell me, how did you appear here?"

Lin Zhiyu swallowed her tight throat. For some reason, her hands were numb.

The man seemed impatient to wait. He twisted his neck, raised his feet, and walked slowly towards Lin Zhiyu.

Lin Zhiyu subconsciously took a step back, but his back hit the cold wall.

There is no way back.

The man said: "I just need a quiet audience, so I'll leave this role to you."

Lin Zhiyu stared at the man in front of her. She opened her mouth and made a slightly hoarse voice, "What do you want to do?"

The man curled his lips and said, "You will see."

As soon as he finished speaking, the man raised his hand and inserted a needle into Lin Zhiyu's arm, and directly pushed the liquid inside.

"You..."

Before the words could be spoken, Lin Zhiyu fell down weakly.

The man emphasized again: "Be sure to be a quiet audience."

Lin Zhiyu gasped and struggled to raise his head, looking at the woman on the operating table who didn't know whether she was unconscious or dead——

She has long hair, very fair skin, and an obvious black mole on her exposed neck.

Lin Zhiyu wanted to hold his hands on the ground to get up, but he couldn't exert any strength.

There was nothing she could do to save the woman.
